status: Local implementation; no commit, push, deployment or cloud changes
workspace: SightseeingShkodra-Web-App, previously explicitly approved by owner because canonical folder is unavailable
root_causes: The sticky winter announcement occupied normal flow above the hero and positioned the header below itself.
The phone hero used a viewport-dependent copy drop and large copy-to-card gap; cards did not receive remaining flex height.
Short/narrow screens were capped at two amenities even when space existed. Auto margins left empty space above amenities.
The fitting budget counted an absolutely positioned availability badge as flow content.
implementation: Phone-only 100dvh minimum with 100svh/100vh fallbacks; safe-area-aware header and stable 44px announcement band.

Announcement overlays within the reserved header area, with scrollable wrapping for unusually long copy; existing button and dialog retained. The band remains reserved when off, preventing vertical displacement.
Existing carousel and cards expand through flex layout; photos have a 64px minimum and consume spare height. Content remains in natural flow when it cannot fit.

Fit chips from measured label wrapping and actual card budget; use existing priority order, retain at least the first measured row, reserve disclosure and price/action space, ignore floating badges, remeasure on viewport/hero/font changes.
All amenities sheet, native swipe/next-card preview and booking handlers preserved. Tablet landscape retains its previous two-chip compact behavior.
screenshots: before-*.png and after-*.png are matching local synthetic fixtures using real shared components and CSS; live-before-390x844.png is the unchanged live site.

verification.browser: Actual headless Google Chrome with mobile/touch emulation; screenshots inspected
verification.checks: See interaction-results.json; browser-check.mjs asserts portrait viewport fit, equal card heights, no text clipping, collisions or horizontal overflow.
verification.types: Passed after retry of transient missing .next generated file; typecheck.log; production build also typechecks
verification.production_build: next build --webpack passes; build.log. Default Turbopack build was interrupted after stalling in compile.
verification.tablet_desktop: 768x1024 and 1440x900 hero/card geometry equals before measurements

limitations: Physical iPhone Safari and Safari toolbar expanding/collapsing are unverified. Safari remote automation was disabled in this environment; viewport-height cycling in Chromium is a substitute for available-height changes only.

568x320 landscape requires normal vertical scrolling so copy, price, status and action remain readable; no fixed-height clipping. Enlarged text and unusually long descriptions can likewise extend the hero.
Preview uses synthetic products and disables booking submission. Existing tests verify product links, isolated booking contexts and dialogs; no real booking created.
Production-build browser parity with real Supabase content was not performed; public content/configuration was not changed.
